units.source_text: 千重子和真一绕过池子，踏上一条昏暗的林荫小道。

en.t: Chieko and Shinichi went around the pond and stepped onto a dim, tree-shaded path.

units.source_text: 嫩叶的清香和湿土的芬芳扑鼻而来。

en.t: The fresh scent of young leaves and the fragrance of damp earth came to their noses.
The tree-shaded path was very short.

units.source_text: 眼前展现一座明亮的庭园，这里的水池比方才的水池还大。

en.t: A bright garden opened before them, and the pond here was even larger than the one before.

units.source_text: 池边的红色垂樱倒映在水中，凄美无比。

en.t: The red weeping cherry trees by the pond were reflected in the water, beautiful with an incomparable sadness.

units.source_text: 外国游客把樱树摄入了镜头。

en.t: Foreign tourists framed the cherry trees in their camera lenses.
